summary: Iteration 6 backend test suite — 30/30 passed in 8.5s (see /app/backend/tests/test_iter6.py). Coverage of all 4 new feature areas: (1) Player Bio & Stats: PATCH sets number/position/stats; sanitisation confirmed (negative -> 0, huge -> 99999 cap); assistant cannot DELETE players (returns 404 due to owner-scoped update). (2) Attendance auto-log: transitioning session.completed false->true appends {week,date,marked_by,marked_by_name}; true->true is idempotent (no duplicate row); true->false removes that week's entry; when the acting user is an assistant, attendance row correctly records assistant's id + name. (3) Assistant Coach flow: POST /api/teams returns 6-digit numeric invite_code and assistant_ids:[]; GET /api/teams role='owner' for owner and 'assistant' for joined user (including in list view); GET /api/teams/{id} hides invite_code from assistants and exposes assistants[] list to owner; POST /api/teams/join accepts valid code, rejects invalid (404), blocks owner self-join (400), idempotent when already a member; POST /api/teams/{id}/invite-code/rotate is owner-only (assistant -> 404) and returns a fresh 6-digit code; DELETE /api/teams/{id}/assistants/{aid} removes assistant and revokes access; POST /api/teams/{id}/leave lets assistant self-remove; assistant CAN patch player photo but CANNOT patch team logo (404) or delete players (404). (4) Media streaming: uploaded a real 4KB fake-mp4 via /api/media/upload; GET returned 200 + Accept-Ranges:bytes and full body integrity for video; Range:bytes=0-99 -> 206 with Content-Range:bytes 0-99/<total>, Content-Length:100 and exact byte slice; mid-range bytes=1000-1499 -> 206 with correct 500-byte slice; malformed Range header (`notbytes=abc`) falls back to 200 full body; image download returns Accept-Ranges:none regardless of Range header; owner-only enforced (403 for other user); soft-delete -> subsequent GET 404. Regression: /api/programs CRUD (POST/GET/DELETE) still green, and /api/programs/{id}/cover happily accepts a video media_id.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:733 in download_media initialises `end` as `total_size - 1 if total_size else None`. If total_size is 0 (record with unknown size), the non-partial branch will still set Content-Length only when total_size is truthy, so `end=None` is unused — but the local variable is confusing. Prefer explicit `end = total_size - 1` and gate all use behind `if total_size`.

server.py leave_team returns 404 'Team not found' when the user isn't an assistant on the team — this conflates 'no team' with 'not a member'. Consider 403 for the latter to help clients distinguish. Non-blocking.

server.py update_player_bio (PATCH /teams/{id}/players/{pid}) is available to both owner and assistants (uses _team_for_user without require_owner). The problem statement says assistants SHOULD NOT edit season stats bio fields, but code allows it. E1 must decide: either (a) split into two endpoints (bio vs stats) with assistant restricted to non-stat fields, or (b) enforce require_owner on stats mutations at the endpoint. Currently assistants can silently overwrite season stats via this route — flagged in review request too. Not tested as a failing case since spec ambiguous ('verify behavior matches').

server.py rotate_invite_code: 10-attempt loop but still updates and returns even if all 10 attempts collided (would overwrite with the last generated code without collision check). Should raise 500 like _ensure_team_invite_code when exhausted.

server.py:717 range parsing accepts multi-range and only reads first; also accepts suffix ranges like 'bytes=-500' partially (start='' becomes 0, end='500'). Spec-wise HTTP allows 'bytes=-500' to mean last 500 bytes — current code interprets it as bytes 0-500. Minor deviation; not a blocker.
download_media reimplements token extraction (cookie/Bearer/?auth=) — 3rd iteration this has been called out. Extract to a shared helper to reduce drift.
test_credentials: coach@basketballaus.com / CoachAdmin2026! — working. Fresh TEST_iter6_asst_* and TEST_iter6_str_* users registered per run.
seed_data_creation: Per test-run: one program (TEST_iter6_prog), one team (TEST_iter6_Team) with one player + assistant + stranger user, one 4KB fake-mp4 upload and one 1x1 PNG upload. Team+program are torn down in fixture teardown; media stays soft-deleted or attached to program cover.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter6.py -o addopts='' -v`. Note: pytest.ini uses xdist by default; the -o addopts='' disables it (fixtures are module-scoped and stateful — running in parallel would corrupt state). One open policy question flagged for main agent: PATCH /api/teams/{id}/players/{pid} lets assistants overwrite season stats; the review request itself notes this as ambiguous ('currently endpoint allows assistants to PATCH bio — verify behavior matches'). If the intended behavior is to block, main agent should split or restrict this endpoint.
